'''Byrneport''' was the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]] located in [[Byrne City]]. The spaceport was destroyed along with the rest of Demophon when the [[Demophon system/Legends|system's]] [[Demophon (star)|star]] went supernova.
